title: Create a service
summary: Add a clear service name, price and timing, then choose where and by whom it can be delivered.

sections.title: Before you begin
sections.body: You need Services configuration access for the affected branches and staff. Receptionists can use eligible services in Calendar and Checkout without being able to change the catalogue.

sections.title: Add the service
sections.body:
1. Open **Services** and select **Add service**.
2. In **Overview**, enter the required **Service name**, **Base price** and positive **Active service time**. Choose **Catalogue type → Standalone service**.
3. Optionally add **Category**, **Client-facing description**, **Processing time** and **Cleanup / buffer**. Choose **Fixed price** or **Starting from** under **Price display**.
4. Review **Active service**.
5. In **Team & locations**, select eligible locations and qualified people. Add exceptions only where needed.
6. In **Booking & rules**, review online visibility, client eligibility, notice, advance booking and deposits.
7. Select **Add service** at the bottom of the drawer.

sections.title: Check the saved service
sections.body: Find the service in the catalogue. A service can be saved before staff or locations are assigned, but **Needs setup** means it is not ready for the intended booking journey. Check a representative booking in Calendar and the public preview if applicable.

sections.title: Common creation mistakes
sections.body: A zero price is a free service and still reserves time. A blank price is not the same as zero. A service’s active state and online visibility are separate. Keep the editor open if save confirmation is pending and use its exact **Retry save** action rather than creating a duplicate.
